decisions.reason: Two-component resin injection is core to the firm's plural-component business and has steady industrial demand.
The second resin unit addresses different specifications and strengthens the product range.
Automatic airless guns serve high-volume coating applications and remain central.
Manual airless guns are still required for smaller jobs and service work.
Air-assisted airless is an established premium coating technology and fits the firm's precision positioning.
The data logger has weaker support on the website and is less central to the core equipment line, making it the most likely candidate for phase-out.
